posts.author: alice_gristle
posts.body:
Hi there sweetie!
It took me the longest time to actually figure out what you wuz askin' for, soooo here's a few pointers!
1) Clueless people like me have no clue, so it always helps if you get SUPER SPECIFIC: explain what "Helluva Boss" is, describe what these charas look like, and outline exactly what you're lookin' for (premade sprites, concept art, generator parts, etc.)
2) I know you posted this in the MZ Resources section, but it helps even more if you describe the scale and style of yo desired assets, like, "I want 48x48 pixel characters", or "I'm looking for full-sized character busts as close as possible to the style of the show" or whatever
3) Post reference images, but be mindful of copyright issues!
As for yo actual request, I'm afraid I'm of zero use, but I hope this helps you make yo point so you can find what you lookin' for!
